limitations: These are explicit, zone-free paths from KiCad direct physical adjacency; same-net name alone never forms a junction.
Path weights use complete native trace-item lengths; unused tails and pad-overlap portions are not clipped. A shortest full-item witness is not equivalent resistance or a mathematical bound on it.
NewSYSrouteitemresistance excludes source/target pads, solder, existing connecting copper and barrel transitions; the separate fullpath witnesses include explicit existing barrels.
20/25 micrometre plating, 1.44/1.60/1.76 mm finished thickness, temperatures and reduced copper/width cases are unqualified sensitivity assumptions, not measured/ordered fabrication values.
No current sharing, skin/proximity effect, contacts, package internals, thermal rise, impedance/EMC, load or board current rating is calculated.
Four new vias belong to CE/CHG controlsignals only; SYS adds no new power via.
